findings.label: Formal-assessment section shows all submissions
findings.detail: LearnerProfile's 'Mga Nakaraang Pagtatasa (Pormal)' sets formalSubmissions = learnerSubmissions, so it lists every submission for the learner rather than filtering to formal assignments. Acceptable for a mock-only first pass; narrow if a true formal-only view is wanted later.

findings.label: Assign loses learner context from profile
findings.detail: LearnerProfile's 'Mag-assign ng Pagtatasa' routes to AssignAssessment, which takes no learnerId and starts with an empty selection, so the viewed learner isn't pre-selected. Non-blocking; consider passing/pre-checking the learner in a later pass.
